tool_args.rationale: The smooth siphon model fits the pilot data but fails fresh confirmation with RMSE 2.806 against a tolerance of 0.045. The high-gradient probe directly tests whether a threshold-triggered loss explains the failure while preserving the base law below threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit the smooth siphon model with wider parameter bounds
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The original fit matches all five pilot points to rounding precision. Those same points cannot tell whether the fresh failure calls for different coefficients or a new high-gradient term.
A threshold above the pilot maximum of 2.34 leaves every pilot prediction unchanged, so neither the threshold nor the loss rate is identified.
This costs more and tests temporal dynamics rather than directly sampling the suspected high-gradient regime at the target horizon.
